# Learned instinct: supply-chain-pin-dependencies (confidence 0.95)

All dependencies must be pinned to exact versions. In Python: `requirements.txt` with hash verification. In Node.js: committed `package-lock.json` with exact versions. In Ansible: `requirements.yml` with exact collection and role versions. Wildcard versions (`>=`, `~`, `^`) in production are a HIGH finding — they allow undeclared dependency updates that break reproducibility and auditability.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 6.3.2; SLSA Level 2 reproducible builds
